# Small-tilt multiface construction — pending independent whole review

This standalone author candidate addresses the full square-free reversible binary
one-port hub architecture with every satellite covered by an arm. The proposed
conclusion is nonexplosion, irreducibility, positive recurrence, and **one explicitly
acquired nonzero exponential stationary total-count moment**. It is not an all-t
moment theorem or an arbitrary weak-reversibility result. No operational chemical,
biological or hardware claim is made.

## Mechanism

`THEOREM_PENDING.md` contains the complete proof and receiving argument. A genuine
sum of all independent-face rational tails is glued by an acyclic proper-subset
transfer, not max/min profiles or cutoffs. The tilt is chosen small after all
weights. An inactive-state indicator pays immigration there; its only adverse
entrance is last-A death, paid by the actual O(N) support-face capture reserve.
All other profile-death costs are paid either by the large-subset capture reserve
or by an explicitly bounded interior residual. No uniform occupation clock,
stationary fiber law, uncharged seed failure or deterministic-permanence premise
is used.

## Code and status

- `multiface.py`: standalone raw recognizer, exact rational constructor, finite
  power expressions, and pointwise scaled-generator evaluator.
- `api.py`: separate raw qualitative recognition (no independent-set enumeration),
  validated mask/exponent/power-bit budget adapter. A quantitative refusal retains
  the raw qualitative match; the theorem remains pending independent acceptance.
- `receive_certificate.py`: same-author canonical receipt comparison and budgeted
  exact expression evaluator. **Not** an independent implementation or review.
- `fixture_certificate.json`: actual acquired triangle-plus-disjoint-edge fixture,
  every hub arm-carrying, one reverse rate perturbed. The old accepted backbone
  recognizer rejects this graph; this is a genuine structural extension if accepted.

All code is local Python standard library. No external source retrieval occurred.

## Reproduce author checks

```sh
python stochastic_multiface_small_t_receiving_v3_20261101/check_author.py
python stochastic_multiface_small_t_receiving_v3_20261101/check_large_tiers.py
python stochastic_multiface_small_t_receiving_v3_20261101/check_receiving.py
python stochastic_multiface_small_t_receiving_v3_

# Additive v3 delta from receiving repair18bd0a2b

Mathematical theorem and constructor are unchanged, respectively dc96226443a99ee0a8541f03cce5af28ff735a95c6855053d223cf87d5001327 and e4f41d32797930155a4e017196636da4ad5968b8ad5519baa5361ad24834fff2.

The v2 evaluator guarded expression structure iteratively but then evaluated it
recursively. A caller could raise max_depth to3000, causing a valid1,100-deep
expression to pass the guard and then hit Python's recursion limit. This is a
real receiving boundary failure, not a mathematical counterexample.

V3 replaces expression arithmetic by iterative visit/multiply/power frames and
a value stack. Guarded input-tree nodes bound these stacks up to a fixed factor;
no recursion limit is assumed even when the explicit depth budget is raised.
Hex tags, exact rational domains and conservative power-bit refusal are retained.

`check_iterative_expression.py` passes17 regressions including1,100/3,000-deep
valid trees,5,000-wide multiplication, default-depth and node refusals, exact
mixed postorder arithmetic and invalid domains. All receiving, guard, API and
repair suites were rerun. The unchanged constructor's component and large-tier
results are retained at their exact e4f41d32 binding. V3 still awaits independent
receiving; neither the v2 freeze nor the separate scalar corollary was overwritten.
